name: watch

summary.en: Lets an agent “watch” a video: downloads it with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg and pulls a transcript, with an optional Gemini path.
summary.zh: 让 Agent “看”视频：用 yt-dlp 下载、用 ffmpeg 抽帧并提取字幕或转写，也可选用 Gemini。

upstreamDescription: Watch a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls the transcript from captions (or local WhisperX / cloud Whisper fallback), and hands the result to the agent so it can answer questions about what's in the video. With a Gemini API key, Google's agentic video model watches the full video instead.
